title: Figure 9: Scanning transmission x-ray microscopy images of CoFe nanopillar magnetization
description: Three-panel figure captioned 'Figure 9. Scanning transmission x-ray microscopy images of Mx (a) and My (b) components of magnetization M combine into the vector field (c), which represents the direction of M in the plane of the CoFe free layer. (Reference 52)'. Panels (a) and (b) are grayscale microscopy images with blue ellipses outlining the element, colored arrows and a '100 nm' scale bar; panel (c) is a blue vector-field map. Section '3.3 STT Applications' begins below.
